knownIssues.symptom: Crash dialog at launch offering to send diagnostics to the developer
Nothing visible for five minutes with the full recipe configuration on an M3 Pro, and a forced reboot after stopping it

The game process starts and stays alive, but no window ever appears, and after several minutes the whole Mac becomes unresponsive and needs a restart (highball-db#356, Apple M5 Pro, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.10, engine r18 with D3DMetal 4 and r19 with D3DMetal 3, the recipe's variables confirmed by 'Metal API Validation Enabled')

On Wine 11 the game starts and then hangs: a black window at 0% CPU for over four minutes on r26 (D3DMetal 4 beta 3), an exit after about 100 seconds with an empty crash dump on r27 (D3DMetal 3). The Mac stayed responsive (M5 Pro, macOS 27.0, highball#537)
